what: Once, at the moment the panel’s leading edge enters the screen in the scroll direction (the 97% line of the screen horizontally, within the bottom 4% vertically), from where the panel was thrown — shifted 3.5% of screen width in the travel direction and 11% of screen height up (9% in the travel direction for vertical scroll), 1.07×, tilted −.035rad — with a spring (accel = −120·displacement − 11.6·velocity, in seconds) it settles in place with a slight wobble. Once it fully leaves the screen (±10%) it re-arms and is thrown again when it comes back — a horizontal reel where work photo panels are laid down like cards dealt onto a table

options.x: Horizontal shift (share of screen width), default .035
options.y: Upward lift on horizontal scroll (share of screen height), default .11
options.y-vertical: Offset in travel direction when scrolling vertically (share of screen height), default .09
options.steady: If 1, no tilt and no shrinking on vertical scroll (large hero photo)
options.axis: x · y — if left empty, x when the data-fx-scroller panel overflows horizontally
options.[data-fx-part=swing]: (If present) inner layer to shake — otherwise the element itself

note: Panels already on screen at first open are not thrown. Several panels share one loop (requestAnimationFrame)

from.where: index.html .gs-plate (original .plate .swing — deal x dir·W·.035 · y −H·.11 (vertical dir·H·.09) · s .07 · r −dir·.035, spring −120v −11.6w, front end .97 · re-arms outside ±10%, lead vertical has no tilt and doesn’t shrink)
